description: This Java class represents a specific type of MMS PDU message called ReadOrigInd, used within an Android MMS library. It provides methods to construct, access, and modify message headers such as date, sender, message ID, read status, and recipient list.

classes.name: ReadOrigInd
classes.description: A class representing the MMS Read-Original-Indication PDU message, with constructors and getter/setter methods for various header fields.

methods.name: ReadOrigInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message type to MESSAGE_TYPE_READ_ORIG_IND. Throws InvalidHeaderValueException if error occurs.

methods.name: ReadOrigInd(PduHeaders headers)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with provided headers.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the list of recipient addresses.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the list of recipient addresses.
